subject: STABLE air-render-plan-opus #1: AIR-derived render plan metadata == m2v on 234/234 captured CA records (host, private lib)
body: C entry tegu_mali_air_render_metadata (new gpu/metal/tegu/mali_graphics_air_plan.inc, included by mali_graphics_air.inc; air_translate_stage split into air_stage_base + adapt, codegen unchanged) produces m2v schema-1 metadata from the two AIR functions + descriptor: layout.sets/push_constants, interface (slots/windows/forms/push/numbered_samplers), dependencies, stages[].specialization, vertex_input, graphics. Host compare tools/plan_vs_m2v.py vs fresh m2v metadata (meta/, dump fixed to pass the single blend like TEGU_PC_AIR_BLEND): 234/234 IDENTICAL on every planner-read field, 0 refused. Deliberate exclusion: m2v ColorWriteRule push fields + graphics.color_write_rules (m2v's own colour rounding emulation, never read by AIR code; sorts after SlotBindOffset so offsets unchanged). Rules restated from metal2vulkan edb177a (link.rs layout/specialize, lower/push.rs, memory/window.rs, view_kind, fact BTreeSet order, link/graphics.rs, link/vertex.rs) incl. two non-obvious ones found by diff: nnan NaN-constant colour stores and self-copies of the fetched attachment are not writes (color_outputs). Everything outside the restated subset refuses with a reason (no approximation). Cold plan cost fixed_frag median 27 ms (includes FS air_to_nir, whose base NIR the codegen then reuses), others 1.3 ms. Private: gpu/build/air-plan-20261028/src (sha plan.inc b5147ff3, air.inc fa863cfa, compiler.c 1f976e4c, .h 0080ba17), lib libs/plan1 b8cfd3e8. Next: Rust tegu_air_render_pipeline_create_planned (air_bridge.rs, appended only) + additive doc(hidden) metal2vulkan RenderPipeline/StageModule::from_parts (needs translator commit+PIN bump by root), then UI corpus pairs, then frontend switch after C6t committed.
